description: JACoW's class for accelerator conference proceedings, jacow v2.7 (2022/02/02) from CTAN and MiKTeX. It is always two columns. a4paper is the option the class's own A4 template uses; it only sets geometry's paper size. Under XeTeX the class loads unicode-math and sets TeX Gyre Termes itself, and it needs nothing declared before \begin{document}, so the preamble is empty.
